paragraphs: A Land Rover S68 engine rebuild starts from £6,500, across all three applications — the Defender Octa, Range Rover SV and Range Rover Sport SV. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most S68 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six S68-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover S68 engine?
faqLeft.a: The S68 is BMW M's twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 petrol engine, used in Land Rover applications from 2024. It produces up to 626-635 hp in the Defender Octa.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the S68?
faqLeft.a: Defender Octa (L663, 2024–present), Range Rover SV (L460, 2024–present), and Range Rover Sport SV (L461, 2024–present).

faqLeft.q: Is the S68 a BMW engine?
faqLeft.a: Yes — the S68 is a BMW M-sourced engine, not a JLR-designed engine. The same engine family powers BMW's own M performance models.

faqLeft.q: Does the S68 differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: The specific tuning and vehicle-specific ancillaries differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an S68 from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically — specific ancillaries and tuning differ by application. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover S68 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, regardless of which of the three S68-equipped models you drive. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on S68 rebuilds across all three Land Rover applications, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on S68 hybrid applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. All S68 applications in the Land Rover range are 48V mild-hybrid, and we account for the relevant hybrid-system ancillaries during a rebuild.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an S68 from a Defender Octa?
faqRight.a: Yes. The S68 in the Defender Octa is one of the applications we work on.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover S68 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S68 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: What are the known issues with the S68?
faqRight.a: Turbocharger problems due to oil starvation are a known characteristic, especially after hot shutdown without a cool-down phase. Increased oil consumption is also documented.
